name: Advertising Entity: Fallback
description: Adds behaviors to replace empty slots with alternative Advertisement.
project_description: Submodule of the Advertising Entity (ad_entity) project. It lets any Advertising entity nominate a second Advertising entity as a fallback: when the original ad slot loads empty, the fallback ad is initialized in its place instead. Configuration is per-entity (a select field added to the Advertising entity form via third-party settings) plus one global timeout setting. The empty-slot detection and swap happen client-side in JavaScript; the module renders both the original and the fallback container into the page, correlates them with a random data attribute, and a timed handler activates the fallback if the original never reports content.
